notes: Tutorial keymap (docs/TUTORIAL-CLI.md / TUTORIAL-GUI.md): standalone 17-key numeric keypad that always types digits regardless of NumLock. Same key order as test-keymap-10key.json; calibrate with --calibrate-simple <UniqIdHex> 17. Single layer. The numpad digit keys and the decimal point are mapped to the main-block digits (KC_1..KC_0) and KC_DOT, which the OS does not reinterpret as Home/End/arrows when NumLock is off. Every other key is native pass-through.
